enum: ATTACK_RESULT { MISS, HIT, CRITICALHIT }

ATTACK: 5
function: attack ROLL:n vs DEFENSE:n {
  if ROLL = 1 { result: MISS }
  if ROLL = 20 {
    if ROLL + ATTACK >= DEFENSE { result: CRITICALHIT }
    result: HIT
  }
  if ROLL + ATTACK >= DEFENSE { result: HIT }
  result: MISS
}
output [attack d20 vs 15] named "attack"

\\\ An untyped empty list adopts the enum type when it is combined with an
\\\ enum member.
output {{}, MISS} named "adopted enum type"

function: pool D:d { result: D }
function: sequence S:s { result: [reverse S] }
function: generic element X:n { result: X }
output [pool d{MISS, HIT}] named "pool constraint"
output [generic element d{MISS, HIT}] named "element constraint"
output [[sequence {MISS, HIT}] contains MISS] named "contains"
output [count {HIT} in [sequence {MISS, HIT, HIT}]] named "count"
output 1@{MISS, HIT} named "first member"
output #{MISS, HIT} named "enum list length"

\\\ Even without outcomes, the distribution retains its enum field schema.
function: typed X:s { result: X }
output [typed {MISS:0}] named "typed empty"

output HIT named "element"
output {MISS, HIT, HIT} named "list"

\\\ Result \\\

"attack"
ATTACK_RESULT,%
MISS,45
HIT,50
CRITICALHIT,5

"adopted enum type"
ATTACK_RESULT,%
MISS,100

"pool constraint"
ATTACK_RESULT,%
MISS,50
HIT,50

"element constraint"
ATTACK_RESULT,%
MISS,50
HIT,50

"contains"
#,%
1,100

"count"
#,%
2,100

"first member"
ATTACK_RESULT,%
MISS,100

"enum list length"
#,%
2,100

"typed empty"
ATTACK_RESULT,%

"element"
ATTACK_RESULT,%
HIT,100

"list"
ATTACK_RESULT,%
MISS,33.33333333333333
HIT,66.66666666666666
